hypothesis: A zero-target-history regional MAP5 algorithm can retain most gauged-station MAP skill while improving transferable spatial prediction and preserving river-network closure.
station_spatial_test: ten outer groups; candidate, prior and reconciliation lambda reselected using only the other groups
whole_tree_test: eight outer groups made from complete terminal trees; all selection repeated without held-out trees
reconciliation: lambda reselected inside every spatial outer training set from [0.01,0.1,1,10]
